senses.gloss:
स्तु स्तु, cl. 2. P. A. स्तौति or स्तवीति (1st
du. स्तुवस् or स्तुवीवस्, 3rd pl. स्तुवन्ति),
स्तुते or स्तुवीते, Impf. अस्तौत् or अस्तवीत् (1st sing.
अस्तवम्), Impv. स्तौतु or स्तवीतु (2nd sing.
स्तुहि or स्तुवीहि), Perf. तुष्टाव (2nd sing. तुष्-
टोथ, 1st du. तुष्टुव, 1st pl. तुष्टुम), तुष्-
टुवे, स्तोष्यति, -ते, अस्तावीत्, अस्तोष्ट, स्तोतुम् or
(according to Vopa-deva also) स्तवितुम् (Ved. Inf.
स्तुषे, स्तवध्यै), to praise, laud, eulogize, glorify,
extol, celebrate; to hymn, praise or celebrate in song,
worship by hymns; cl. 1. A. स्तवते (Ved. स्तवे),
to be praised (Ved.): Pass. स्तूयते, &c., Aor.
अस्तावि, to be praised, &c.: Caus. स्तावयति, Aor.
अतुष्टवत्: Desid. तुष्टूषति, -ते: Intens.
तोष्टूयते, तोष्टोति; [cf. perhaps Gr. στό-μα,
Æol. στύ-μα: Goth. staua, ‘a judge;’ stauja,
‘to judge.’]

स्तुत्, त्, त्, त् (at the end of comps.), praising, cele-
brating, (see देव-स्त्˚, यथा-स्त्˚, छन्दः-स्त्˚.)

स्तुत, अस्, आ, अम्, praised, eulogised, hymned,
[]
glorified; flattered; (अस्), m. epithet of Śiva.
—स्तुत-
स्वामि-क्षेत्र, अम्, n., N. of a sacred place.

स्तुति, इस्, f. praise, eulogy, commendation, adula-
tion, flattery; N. of Durgā.
—स्तुति-गीत, अम्, n. a
song of praise, panegyric.
—स्तुति-पद, अम्, n. an
object of praise.
—स्तुति-पर्यवसायिन्, ई, इनी, इ,
concluding or ending in praise (said of ironical
निन्दा or censure).
—स्तुति-पाठक, अस्, m. ‘praise-
reciter,’ a panegyrist, encomiast, bard, herald (espe-
cially one who accompanies a chief or an army, =
वन्दिन्, q. v.).
—स्तुति-प्रिय, अस्, आ, अम्, fond of
praise or adulation.
—स्तुति-वाद, अस्, m. a laudatory
speech, panegyric.
—स्तुति-व्रत, अस्, m. ‘one whose
duty is praise,’ a bard, &c., (see above.)

स्तुत्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be praised, laudable, praise-
worthy.
स्तुत्वा, ind. having praised, having glorified.
स्तुवत्, अन्, अती, अत्, praising, glorifying.

स्तुवान, अस्, आ, अम्, praising, glorifying; being
praised or celebrated, (Sāy. = स्तूयमान, Ṛg-veda
VII. 96, 3.)
स्तुवेय्य, अस्, m., Ved., N. of Indra.
स्तुवेय्य स्तुवेय्य, स्तुषेय्य. See col. 2.
स्तूयमान, अस्, आ, अम्, being praised or lauded.

स्तुक स्तुक, अस्, m. (probably another form
of स्तुप, but cf. स्तवक), a collection of hair, knot
or braid of hair, (Sāy. = केश-सङ्घात); (आ), f. a
knot or braid of hair (= केश-वेणी; cf. पृथु-
ष्ठुक, सहस्र-स्˚); a curl of hair, bunch of curly
hair between the horns of a bull; (according to Sāy.
on Ṛg-veda IX. 97, 17. स्तुका = अपत्य; cf. तोक);
a hip, thigh, (according to some = जघन.)
—स्तुका-विन्, ई, इनी, इ, Ved. possessing bunches of
hair, (according to Sāy. on Ṛg-veda VIII. 74, 13.
स्तुकाविनः = ऊर्णायवः.)
—स्तुका-सर्गम्, ind.
after the form of a curl or knot of hair (= स्तुका
यथा सृज्यते तथा).

स्तुच् स्तुच्, cl. 1. A. स्तोचते, तुष्टुचे,
स्तोचितुम्, to be bright or pellucid; to
be propitious or pleased: Caus. स्तोचयति, -यितुम्,
Aor. अतुष्टुचत्: Desid. तुस्तुचिषते or तुस्तो-
चिषते: Intens. तोष्टुच्यते, तोष्टोक्ति.
स्तुनक स्तुनक, अस्, m. a goat (= छाग).

स्तुप स्तुप, अस्, m. [cf. स्तूप], Ved. a knot
of hair, top-knot; the collection of curly hair be-
tween the horns of a bull; the horns of a bull.

स्तूप, अस्, m. (according to Sāy. fr. rt. स्त्यै;
according to Uṇādi-s. III. 25. fr. rt. स्तु), a heap or
pile of earth, any heap or pile or mound; a Buddhist
monument (commonly called Tope; it is a kind of
Tumulus erected over sacred relics of the great
Buddha or on spots consecrated as the scenes of
his acts); a funeral pile; a heap of rays, accumu-
lated rays (Ved., according to Sāy. स्तूपैः = तप्तै
रश्मिभिः, Ṛg-veda VII. 2, 1); (according to
Śabda-k.) = निष्प्रयोजन; = बल.

स्तुभ् 1. स्तुभ् (connected in some senses
with rt. स्तम्भ्, and in these senses also
identical with rt. स्तुम्भ् below, and perhaps ori-
ginally ‘to stamp’), cl. 1. A. स्तोभते, तुष्टुभे,
स्तोभितुम्, to stop, suppress; to paralyze, stupefy;
to be stupefied; cl. 1. P. स्तोभति, to praise, (in
this sense probably connected with and developed
out of rt. स्तु); to celebrate, worship (Ved., in
Naigh. III. 14. स्तोभति is enumerated among the
अर्चति-कर्माणः): Caus. स्तोभयति, &c., to
praise (Ved.).

2. स्तुभ्, प्, m., Ved. one who stops, (perhaps
the words त्रि-ष्टुभ् and अनु-ष्टुभ् are to be
referred to this sense, the metre requiring regular
stoppages or pauses); one who praises, a worshipper
(= स्तोतृ, Naigh. III. 16).

स्तुभ्वन्, आ, m., Ved. one who praises, a praiser,
(Sāy. = स्तोतृ.)
स्तुभ स्तुभ, अस्, m. a goat (= छाग).

स्तुम्भ् स्तुम्भ् (connected with rt. स्तम्भ्,
and in some senses indentical with rt.
1. स्तुभ् above; in native lists written स्तुन्भ्), cl.
5. 9. P. स्तुभ्नोति, स्तुभ्नाति, to stop; to stupefy; to
expel; [cf. Gr. στύφ-ω, στυφελός, στυμνός,
στυφεδανός, τυφεδανός, probably also τυφός,
τυφώδης; perhaps Old Germ. stumph, stumbal; Angl.
Sax. stypel, dumb; Goth. dumb.]

स्तूप् स्तूप् (probably derived fr. स्तूप
below), cl. 4. 10. P. स्तूप्यति, स्तूप-
यति, &c., to heap up, pile, collect; to erect.
